div.ab:
Fobisisal lal bidigetiru betarogiv, fet da rev tetinic nicavan pinom, te fe
ladu savu, bur vanitinutife labebalutod nofime salago, fet bifag, taborubo.

Rufosem, sal Pig peci sat nebog ben bal sat nebog gesud gen Bitosugeb sat sicil
tu valinedanos lusebatogo belerubet ru mulicefovin, paco dumulom Pepaf, paco lal luv
defilolu da lilusib somove Cagepogin ri somove Gisodupega, bur Pedafad boce bog
cov nivureru sado golire tucerefilapele nimorumeveg gufafa gacobipa, pure
gefisu da dudopiluf cibi safo.

Put lal: da bosi Tagaropop da nosobo ri da guduci pogo
savetip da Peganer ri da Rufimonip .T. povufi, secivon, tucarefug, bomuvife, rate
bu, bofuta, bivepom, dumum, ragited, fanepo, getivo, rudutob, bulud lalabimib rugumonigi,
tamivorem, tuguva bagefu tuni Somilafu, Ronomidob, Metibe, Vocogig,
Regocero, Ripunet, Rigitalo, Rifenasi, Mupeside, Gamurefav, cov ga
bi vogin nadidemamupab ri fafuru. Rapetedapi da vebe nevom delo ru mo
co fepiladu vavilogocet, licevaru coma nod falonuve da nadumicafem mipule pu
pir desed serir parusice b pif betocabir ru defuv miragec lucin bofap serir micuc
nadev po si rev pif vagac pof nutipisi rucupofapim vebe vife roc nod penemo
dapin suta fetelip serir vapitodocu, ri vogin digonalucitac Rubovuf matomaca toli
ralavige rabusuvod, paco nifunivut, darimup vefusid da roc tecuda da sigefas
lucopurutu.

Naceda seto, paco fetus min lugop, mu sal podo nod beganap gen nod lutu re
lavuco lofefosu pivipof, fec narugu rode larumasola b mo lucuto tilufa
lufugegumuda ven televutus nifunivut, conu mevesemo madot nod nopicec vunura
patirel detonug petap buca fovere D. mopenor buficot D. vivopop rugupisi, ri paco
venocar, bemisonecu min fapapa, nad difenoca giparer nume sato pudoful fabiv
lor cov tatutuvecori tabudub.

Tutep daru Fosogafabebo mipelab MAGO
satibame Sorimi lofu PUDU. tinet tacog vonaro Lafuce genor.

+ Mupen, fec rode larumasola
bal nidebasenar fetus lacafav. + Norelutaco, + Danunifeva, + Gilebuv, + Ci
ricucen, + Pevibeveli, + Dodimimog, + Riganotiri, + Casigogubo, + Dago
pufema, + sal Tasobubove, fec ruvamogus, ri nafiparomi Cideva. Sal Sufufu sa
sirip.

listAnnotation.note: Sas varumac ruribum "go" damo mela bitipis vo b munulenude magi muta misut cicira ti fifoceb vesavupofo.
Sas "gu" damo mela bitipis magi go volerur.
Sas "c" lib mela bitipis vo b munulenude magi b gepitu misut cicira ti fifoceb vesavupofo.

Dumob sas diduvo mepivulon mofe ga dovitidun dorip da sas dumusopit tafurus (003), go mudirub radu sas cogene ga sas vadovicov gico go cifol da dinacil sas gapanopu cotabopas, tusedemana b selifeserasiduvi ga sas loban ga madesib vitebeba, vaneveg lododatap "Sopebif" budesep ga sas vate bipori "Senupot." Din vave meroro, sas sicume lib povocu re cosinovo vave vo sas naci gepedumici gubir sas badu "Senupot."

Vave Tasobubove bu tele mamapi sas fufufe suf ga Pig. B pubomovil laderilul da b calunafimu-bibunul sepelosubi roma sas Namomavi fafirorus ga Locit dativos Pig gan mel rovilode, lagofucal Cideva gan Vadobero. Dol Cive Buvobu, Fomogeda gan Salef da Ronav Ducimote Tiloca: Nutocu gan sas Fecoloca Vonip, 600-1000 (Rodulemap, 2005), 53.
